messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: Noor Patel is joining Redwood Inference as Senior Director, Runtime & Model Ops, start date July 1. This is a consolidation role to streamline deploy -> runtime handoffs. Were opening an internal-only 5-day window for a senior infra backfill and need a short rotation lead for 6 weeks to cover model rollout vault work. Details below.

Tom (CTO): Welcome Noor! This merger should cut friction between serving and ops teams. We'll want clear SLAs and a short transition plan.

Noor Patel: Hi all 9 excited to join. First week I'll review the last 90 days of incidents and meet folks owning deploys and caching. Prefer async onboarding but happy to jump into a live war-room if needed.

Evan (Eng Manager - Runtime): Internal backfill (Senior Infra Engineer L5) apps open now through Apr 22. Prefer folks with deploy pipeline (argo) + cache/KV experience. We'll run interviews Apr 26-30 with a target offer May 10.

Lina (Talent): Internal link: <https://company.internal/hiring/runtime-modelops-l5> 9 please include a one-liner about relevant incident/on-call work. Internal window closes Apr 22.

Zoe (SRE): I can cover the rotation lead for 6 weeks starting July 1 if needed, and will prepare the "deploy safety" checklist this week.

Anita (People Ops Bot): Created calendar events: "Noor intro 9 all-hands" on July 3 and "ModelOps hiring panel" Apr 27. Invitations sent to Runtime, Model Serving, SRE, and DevEx.

Maya (People Ops): Quick action list:
- Lina: open internal window + link (due Apr 22)
- Evan: hiring rubric + interview panel (by Apr 24)
- Noor: office hours week of July 4 (sign-up sheet to follow)
- Zoe: provisional rotation lead & checklist (confirm by May 15)
- People Ops: publish transition doc and dotted-line obligations (by Apr 30)

If you're planning to apply or nominate someone internally, DM Lina. Please react with :wave: if you saw this.
